title: Sticky element backgrounds must branch on visualDesignRefresh flag
answers: Why does a sticky header/footer have the wrong background color in the visual refresh theme?
Sticky toolbar/footer background looks inconsistent with the new design
How should background color be set for sticky/fixed-position elements?
What color token to use for sticky headers under visual refresh
body:
Symptom: sticky-positioned headers/footers (toolbars, modal headers, dashboard footer) show the old canvas/primary background color and look out of place once visual refresh is enabled.
Root cause: getStyles() used a single hardcoded theme.colors.background.* token regardless of theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh, so sticky surfaces didn't pick up the refreshed palette.
Fix pattern: in getStyles(theme), read `const visualRefreshEnabled = theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh;` and set `background: visualRefreshEnabled ? theme.colors.background.page : theme.colors.background.canvas` (or .primary) for any `position: sticky` element's background.
Constraints: applies specifically to sticky/fixed elements whose background was previously canvas or primary; non-sticky surfaces follow other refresh rules and aren't covered by this pattern.
applies: Any component defining styles for a position:sticky element via getStyles(theme: GrafanaTheme2) in public/app
